issues.description: Farm song method naming is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML specifies a public method Farm.printFarmSong() (and a private helper singFarmSongVerse(Animal)), but both template and solution expose the public entry point as singFarmSong(). Students following the statement will implement/call printFarmSong(), while the provided starter code (and reference) use singFarmSong(), causing confusion and likely test/API mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the public API name across all artifacts: either rename Farm.singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() in template+solution (and update Main/commented example), or update the problem statement/UML to require singFarmSong() instead of printFarmSong().
